spec.name: Reversal v39
spec.notes: Fade the last move, rebalanced often.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 2.5, annual return 13%, maximum drawdown 4%.

verdict.opinion: The strategy relies on a very limited research process (only 4 trials across 3 specifications), which is insufficient to establish statistical robustness. The backtest covers the entire available sample without a dedicated out-of-sample validation period, creating a high risk of overfitting to historical noise. While the strategy logic (mean reversion) is standard, the performance metrics lack the necessary rigor to justify deploying real capital. I recommend paper trading to verify if the signal holds up in live market conditions before committing any funds.
